claims.text: SLS Puerto Madero is SLS's first hotel in South America.

findings.quote: bringing SLS’ signature ambiance to its first hotel in South America

claims.text: The hotel is at Juana Manso 1725 in Puerto Madero, Buenos Aires.

findings.quote: Juana Manso 1725 (C1107CHI)
Puerto Madero, Buenos Aires

claims.text: The suites were designed by Italian architect Piero Lissoni.

findings.quote: Designed by world-renowned Italian designer and architect Piero Lissoni, each of the 58 contemporary suites

claims.text: Each suite has floor-to-ceiling windows leading to a private balcony overlooking downtown Buenos Aires or the nearby docks.

findings.quote: Each has floor-to-ceiling windows leading to a private balcony that overlooks downtown Buenos Aires or the nearby docks.

claims.text: Rooms have hardwood floors, a black and white color palette and rainfall shower heads.

findings.quote: Rooms feature hardwood floors, a black and white color palette, low-slung beds, rainfall shower heads in the peekaboo bathrooms

claims.text: The minibar is stocked with local snacks and wines.

findings.quote: mini bar stocked with local snacks and wines

claims.text: LEYNIA is an all-day Argentinean grill influenced by flavors from Japan, built around open flame cooking.

findings.quote: an all-day Argentinean grill influenced by flavors from Japan and celebrating the rustic allure of open flame cooking in a chic, modern setting

claims.text: Leynia's evening menu includes open-flame grilled meats, ossobuco empanadas, Patagonian trout ceviche and teriyaki style shrimp.

findings.quote: which in the evening becomes a steakhouse with a modern Japanese twist—think open-flame grilled meats, ossobuco empanadas, Patagonian trout ceviche, and teriyaki style shrimp

claims.text: The full-service Ciel Spa has steam rooms and relaxation areas.

findings.quote: Indulge at the full-service Ciel Spa, featuring steam rooms, relaxation areas and treatments

claims.text: Spa massages and facials use the Yonka skincare brand.

findings.quote: a trio of treatment rooms for massages and facials using Yonka skincare brand

claims.text: The gym is open to all guests.

findings.quote: The Gym at SLS Puerto Madero is open to all guests

claims.text: Rooms are listed as pet friendly.

findings.quote: Pet Friendly

claims.text: The lobby has an LED-lit installation by local artist Eugenio Cuttica of fiberglass figures standing atop white chairs, in rows that extend from the lobby floor onto the wall.

findings.quote: a LED-lit installation by local artist Eugenio Cuttica of a group of fiberglass figures standing atop white chairs in rows that extend from the lobby floor onto the wall

claims.text: The landscaping is by Enzo Enea.

findings.quote: Lose yourself in the verdant landscaping of Enzo Enea.

claims.text: The private balconies are furnished with a pair of butterfly chairs.

findings.quote: private balconies furnished with a pair of butterfly chairs

claims.text: There is a south-facing outdoor pool with a spacious sundeck.

findings.quote: a south-facing pool with spacious sundeck
Take a refreshing dip in the outdoor pool

claims.text: The hotel is a short walk from Santiago Calatrava's rotating pedestrian bridge, Puente de la Mujer, and from the Fragata Sarmiento, a historic naval ship that is now a museum.

findings.quote: is a short walk to Santiago Calatrava’s rotating pedestrian bridge, Puente de la Mujer, as well as a historic naval ship, Fragata Sarmiento, which now serves as a museum

claims.text: Puerto Madero is a converted docklands district: its old docks and warehouses are now office buildings, apartments, restaurants and bars.

findings.quote: Puerto Madero’s old docks and warehouses have been converted or transformed into sleek office buildings, posh apartment buildings, restaurants, and bars

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes the modern design may not suit travelers who prefer traditional luxury.
